news.title: Baseten Launches Sandboxes for Long-Running, Stateful AI Agents
Baseten launches Grid, a router that sends coding tasks to open models to cut costs by about 70%
Baseten Launches Grid to Route and Govern Enterprise AI Coding

bullets: Own the product roadmap for Grid, from early developer adoption to production deployments and enterprise expansion.
Work with researchers and engineers to improve intelligent model selection, routing policies, fallbacks, and controls.
Build evaluation frameworks that measure real-world outcomes, including task quality, completion time, latency, and total cost.
Shape the developer experience for onboarding, configuration, observability, and routing decisions.
Help customers understand why a model was selected and give them confidence and control over how routing behaves.
Own how workloads scale and where they land, from autoscaling to demand (up under load, down to zero when idle) to a single placement policy that expresses region, compliance…
Give compliance-bound workloads right-of-way on sensitive capacity.
Make production inference reliable by default, so every request reaches a healthy replica and rolling deploys never drop traffic.
Define region-aware routing, with multi-region and active-active failover as first-class policy, plus health-aware recovery from stuck or bad replicas.
Build the release engine beneath safe rollouts: the traffic-shifting that powers canary, shadow, and A/B, along with warm-ups, drain, and probes.
